instructions.question: What attitude does this Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post show: approval or hope, plain information or banter, or blame, frustration, mockery or fear?
instructions.rule: Neutral covers name tags, statistics, polite data requests, plain questions, practical suggestions, calm advice and light banter about cities 'leading'. Negative needs one of these, even when phrased as a joke or a question: blame, mockery of the numbers as fake, fed-up frustration, insults, sarcasm at the government, or fear of catastrophe. Positive needs praise, thanks, relief at good numbers, or hope for zero cases; praise mixed with criticism is still positive.

neutral.what: Tags, statistics, observations, polite requests for details, plain questions, practical suggestions, calm mask reminders, playful banter.
examples: Besnik Prekazi
Lejoni me u bo testet edhe ne laboratore private! (Allow testing in private labs too!)
Vushtria on top çdo nat (Vushtrria on top every night)
neutral.cues: personal names, publikoni (publish), pse (why), ma gjall (livelier), on top, hahaha
neutral.not_for: Questions or jokes that call the numbers fake, blame someone, insult people or sound fed up are negative.

positive.what: Praise or thanks to doctors or the institute, congratulations, hope or prayers for no cases, cheering at recoveries or falling numbers.
examples: Respekt per punen tuaj (Respect for your work)
shpresoj qe ta kalojmë këtë gjendje me sa më pak pasoja. (I hope we get through this with as few consequences as possible.)
Ajde ma gjall ma gjall t sherum (Come on, more and more recovered)
positive.cues: bravo (well done), respekt (respect), faleminderit (thanks), urime (congratulations), shpresoj (I hope), inshallah (God willing), asnje rast (no cases), mir (good)
positive.not_for: 'Ma gjall' cheering of new infections is neutral.

negative.what: Blame of government or citizens, claims of invented numbers, fed-up frustration, insults, sarcastic gloating, fear or despair.
examples: Qeveria koti ika fajet (The Kurti government is to blame)
Veq shifren e par pja ndrroni se tekstin tjeter veq copy paste po get (You only change the first number, the rest is copy paste)
U ba bajat me ka 200 mo  ndrrone pak (It's stale with 200 a day, change it a bit)
negative.cues: faj (blame), rrena (lies), aparati (the machine), bajat (stale), boll (enough), injoranta (ignorant), turp (shame), katastrof (catastrophe), e hupi kontrollen (lost control)
negative.not_for: Data requests, practical proposals or light banter without blame are neutral.
